title: Angela BP Possible NDE 9114
content: I was diagnosed with endometriosis, so I needed surgery to have it removed. While in surgery, I remember seeing a vast amount of grass; high-grain straws in a huge meadow. I was happy beyond words and dancing in the meadow. The sun was extremely bright, warm and safe. The color of the sun was so vivid. Yellow light spread across my face as I danced and swayed. I don't remember hearing music. I do remember feeling extremely loved. I felt pure joy that radiated through my skin. I have never felt these extreme emotions in my earthly life. My mom and husband said they felt worried that something happened to me because it was such a long surgery. My doctor told me that the endometriosis spread everywhere, including my bowels. In answer to a prior question, he said that hopefully, one day with the aid of drugs that I would become pregnant. I was depressed after coming back to my life. I didn't know where I went during this procedure, nor did I think a near death experience. I am not aware of any complications during the surgery. I don't remember sharing this experience with anyone until recently. People have claimed drugs from surgery made me hallucinate. I didn't entirely agree with them and after reading other people's experiences from your book (Evidence of the Aferlife), I'm almost positive I had an NDE. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: It was around 2004 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain. While under general anesthesia. Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal. I was having surgery and the experience happened while under anesthesia. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I was under anesthesia. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I had no sense of time. I felt carefree. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Everything was bright, but the sun was like it was close enough to touch. It was so yellow. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. My hearing was the same. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes The light was shining on my face while I swayed in a meadow of grass with long grains of wheat interspersed in it. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. This place seemed fake, something that one can only imagine. I was alone, but not scared or nervous. What emotions did you feel during the experience? So happy, overjoyed and love Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic I was a person who prayed often. What is your religion now? unknown Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Uncertain Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes The love that I felt came from no human being. It could only be from God. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? I was uncertain if an afterlife exists. I said it was the light that people always say when they see when they die. I felt it could be God, providing me proof of a greater life than of life on Earth. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes I just felt love. I felt safe and so beyond words of Happiness. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life. My daughter was born sick. I met a nurse in the hospital who introduced me to God in a different way than I knew. I prayed different and grew closer to God. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I felt like I couldn't explain it to people. I was depressed for a week. Everyone assumed my experience happened from the surgery, but I think it was from what I felt after coming back to my earthy body. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I saw my girls before they were born. I know when someone is sick or depressed. I feel things very often. I predict death sometimes and pregnancy. I feel emotions strongly. I want to save the world but can't. Also, the devil would attack me often in my dreams. I would get strangled, or abused from the devil. I would only wake up by screaming the name of Jesus. The dreams were real as could be. Also, I sleep with rosary beads and had a blessing not too long ago. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I think the light was a Godly light. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I only first shared this experience with my husband, mom and friend last year. They didn't quite believe me or thought it might be the drugs during surgery. I even asked an anesthesiologist and she said that people just dream. I know of no one who had a procedure that also had a dream or experience like mine. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I kept playing it over and over in my mind and knew it was real. This was nothing from an earthy imagination. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. I read your book and was crying. For years I didn't know what the experience was. I knew I wasn't crazy. I just couldn't find much information on my experience. I now know from others; it was what I thought! God and God's love. Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Yes Did the questions asked and information that you provided accurately and comprehensively describe your experience? Uncertain. I would like to hear other people and their experiences.

environment.environment_other_detail: A huge meadow with tall grass/high-grain straws and long grains of wheat interspersed; extremely bright, warm sun; vivid yellow light shining on her face.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Surgery for endometriosis under general anesthesia.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience occurred while under general anesthesia for surgery; later reported distressing dreams of 'the devil' attacking her, waking by screaming the name of Jesus; she reported sleeping with rosary beads and later receiving a blessing.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was happy beyond words and dancing in the meadow.” “The sun was extremely bright, warm and safe.” “I felt pure joy that radiated through my skin.” “The love that I felt came from no human being. It could only be from God.” “Experience was definitely real.”
